battle.name: 邦角戰役 (468年)
battle.brief: 公元468年7月25日，里奧一世遣巴西利斯庫率數百艘船遠征軍渡海攻擊汪達爾王國，艦隊在邦角外海擊潰汪達爾分遣艦隊；根瑟里克卻以假報叛軍的情報引開錨地，入夜放火船燒毀大批羅馬船。卡面秦連弩為中國連發弩機，與本役相隔六百餘年並不在現場，同期地中海的對應物是維特魯威記載的連發弩砲。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是東羅馬帝國對北非汪達爾王國的一次大規模海陸遠征，發生於公元468年，戰場在今突尼斯北部的邦角外海。羅馬一方由皇帝里奧一世下詔組織，統兵者是軍事總督巴西利斯庫，率領由地中海各屬地與皇都駐軍抽調的龐大艦隊與陸軍，其中大量兵員是受雇於帝國的匈人、阿蘭人與其他草原部族騎手。羅馬以西西里島的敘拉古為集結點，糧秣由西西里與埃及的常備漕糧供應，艦隊的水手與划槳手多來自沿海行省，另有安條克與色雷斯的工匠隨船修造。汪達爾一方是根瑟里克治下的王國，首都在迦太基，國土包括今突尼斯、阿爾及利亞東部以及撒丁尼亞、科西嘉等島嶼的沿海；其海軍以小型快速艇與改裝商船為主，分隊分散、靠岸上基地補給，國王本人坐鎮迦太基掌握全局。羅馬的目標是切斷汪達爾的海上掠奪路線、反攻迦太基；汪達爾的目標則是避免在海上被拖入消耗戰，盡量拖延帝國攻勢、留住劫掠所得。羅馬的阿非利加行省此時由汪達爾控制，本是帝國最富庶的穀物與橄欖油產區之一，其失守使羅馬每年失去可觀的稅收與兵源，這是里奧一世非打不可的背景。第三方並非單一盟友：不列顛的軍團與高盧總督區的資源雖未直接參戰，卻不斷收到求援的訊號；沿岸的柏柏爾部族在戰亂中依附強者，兩軍都試圖以物資與護商換取支持。整體而言，這是一場帝國在失去地中海西岸之後、企圖用一次會戰翻盤的總體戰，規模之大在五世紀的歐洲沒有先例。
countriesEn: This war was a large Roman amphibious expedition against the Vandal kingdom of North Africa, fought in 468 CE in the waters off Cape Bon on the coast of modern Tunisia. The Roman side was set in motion by an imperial order of Emperor Leo I and was led by the magister militum Basiliscus, who commanded an enormous fleet and army drawn from the provinces of the Mediterranean and from the garrison of the capital; a large share of the manpower consisted of Hunnic, Alan and other steppe horsemen in Roman service. The Romans mustered on Sicily, using Syracuse as the assembly point, drew their grain and rations from the routine annona shipments of Sicily and Egypt, and manned the oars with sailors and rowers recruited from the coastal provinces, while Antiochene and Thracian craftsmen travelled with the fleet to effect repairs. The Vandal side was the kingdom of Genseric, whose capital was Carthage and whose territory covered modern Tunisia, eastern Algeria and the coasts of Sardinia and Corsica; its navy rested on small fast craft and converted merchant hulls, squadrons dispersed and supplied from shore bases, while the king himself stayed at Carthage to direct events. The Roman aim was to cut the Vandal raiding route and to counter-attack into Carthage; the Vandal aim was to avoid a war of attrition at sea, to stall the imperial offensive and to keep the proceeds of piracy. Roman Africa Proconsularis, then in Vandal hands, had been one of the empire's richest sources of grain and olive oil, and its loss cost Rome both revenue and recruits, which is why Leo I considered the campaign unavoidable. There was no single third-party ally: the legions of Britain and the resources of the Gaul prefecture did not fight here but were kept informed by desperate reports, and the Berber tribes of the coast attached themselves to whoever could supply them, both sides trying to buy support with goods and safe conduct for commerce. Altogether this was an attempt by an empire that had lost the western shore of the Mediterranean to reverse the situation in a single set-piece battle, on a scale without precedent in fifth-century Europe.
people: 決定這場戰役走向的有三個層次的人。皇帝里奧一世是發動者：在汪達爾連續劫掠阿非利加行省、又襲擊西西里與巴利阿里群島之後，他力主用一次傾國遠征換取主動，朝中對出兵與否並非沒有異議，最終批准了這個冒險方案。巴西利斯庫是統帥，他以軍事總督身分率艦隊渡海，在邦角外海贏得一場乾脆的海戰，卻在隨後的欺敵與火船面前功虧一簣；此役之後他一度於475年登上皇位，隨即被其兄芝諾推翻，遠征的失敗也成為他失勢的背景之一。根瑟里克是汪達爾國王，他沒有親率分隊出海硬拼，而是留在迦太基，得到消息後立刻抓住羅馬遠征的弱點：遠征軍必須依賴甲板上的淡水與糧食，必須在狹窄海灣錨泊，於是製造假情報，聲稱帝國在阿非利加的軍隊（一般認為指阿斯帕爾之子阿爾薩基烏斯所部）已經叛變並正撲向羅軍，逼巴西利斯庫把艦隊撤到岸邊最易被攻擊的位置，再在夜裡放出火船。史家普羅科匹烏斯是記錄者，他留下的遠征軍規模數字與戰鬥經過，是今天研究這場戰爭的主要依據；他的敘述帶有為皇帝辯護的傾向，把遠征的敗績說成是被欺騙與意外，而不是統帥的失斷。汪達爾方面的海軍由國王派出的親族與將領率領，分遣小艇在外海迎敵，一接戰即損失慘重，這些指揮官的姓名在殘存的編年史中多已無從查考。
peopleEn: Three layers of people shaped the course of this war. Emperor Leo I was the initiator: after the Vandals had plundered the province of Africa and struck at Sicily and the Balearic Islands, he pressed for one all-out expedition in exchange for the initiative, and the court was not without dissent before the risky plan was approved. Basiliscus was the commander: as magister militum he carried the fleet across the sea and won a clean naval battle off Cape Bon, only to be undone by deception and fire ships a few days later; he was pushed onto the throne in 475 and immediately overthrown by his brother Zeno, and the failure of this expedition formed part of the background to his fall. Genseric, king of the Vandals, did not sail out with a squadron to trade blows, but remained at Carthage and seized on the weakness of the Roman expedition the moment the news reached him: the expedition depended on water and provisions carried in the ships, and it had to anchor in a narrow bay. He therefore fabricated a report claiming that the Roman army in Africa, generally identified with that of Aspar's son Arsacius, had revolted and was marching on the Roman force, forcing Basiliscus to withdraw the fleet from open water to the shore where it was most exposed, and then launched fire ships that night. The historian Procopius is the recorder: his figures for the size of the expedition and his account of the fighting remain the main basis for studying this war; his narrative has a tendency to defend the emperor, presenting the failure as deception and accident rather than as the misjudgement of a commander. The Vandal naval detachment was led by relatives and officers sent out by the king; their small craft met the Roman line offshore and were cut to pieces on contact, and the names of these commanders can no longer be recovered from the surviving chronicles.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是秦連弩：以弩機儲力、上弦一次可連續發射數十箭的中國連發弩機，設計成熟於戰國末至漢初，其價值在於把拉弦這個最耗體力的步驟交給機括，讓射手可以蹲在城堞或船舷後面以腳踏機、連續壓制接近的目標。按史料，秦連弩是中國的形制（諸葛弩的說法最早見於後漢書的記載），本役在北非，相隔六百餘年、橫越大陸，它並不在現場，這一點必須說清楚。與它同屬一個技術家族、並在晚期羅馬世界確實存在的，是維特魯威《建築十書》所記的連發弩砲：一具可由少數人操作的弩機，箭矢排入匣中，扣下機括便連續射出，同樣把儲力機關用在投射武器上；此外還有希羅記載的多發弩（polydorus），以及拜占庭皇帝里奧三世《戰術》提及的架在支架上、可單人操作的輕型連弩（cheirobalistra），後者與中國連弩在一人一機、踏板發射的形制上最為接近。就本役實際使用的裝備而言，羅馬艦隊以圓腹的運輸兼戰鬥船（dromon）為主，數量龐大，吃水深、載貨多，船上裝備弩砲、投石與角弓手登陸隊，帆用亞麻，部分染成紫色，作為皇權的標記；陸軍是標準的晚期羅馬式步兵裝束，短劍與劍盾，加上弩手與投石手。汪達爾方面的裝備以小艇為主，另有專門用於火攻的船隻，船頭裝著盛有油脂與硫磺的陶罐，並有沿岸的防禦工事、封鎖港口的器材，以及迦太基的城牆弓弩。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow: a Chinese magazine crossbow that stores the pull of the bow in a mechanism, so that a single loading of the string allows dozens of bolts to be fired in succession. Its design matured between the late Warring States and the early Han; its value lies in handing the most exhausting part of the operation, the drawing of the string, over to the mechanism, so that a trooper can crouch behind a parapet or a ship's rail and keep a steady rate of fire on anyone approaching. Historically the repeating crossbow was a Chinese form; the name of the Zhuge crossbow appears earliest in the Hou Hanshu. This battle took place in North Africa, more than six centuries later and on the far side of a continent, and the weapon was not on the field, and that has to be said plainly. Of the same technical family and genuinely present in the late Roman world is the repeating ballista described by Vitruvius in De architectura: a engine worked by a few men, with the bolts laid in a magazine and released successively by a trigger, applying the same principle of a stored-power mechanism to a missile weapon. To the same family belong the polydorus of Hero and the light crossbow mounted on a stand and worked by a single man, the cheirobalistra mentioned in the Tactica of the Byzantine emperor Leo III, the last being closest in form to the Chinese type, with one man, one machine and a foot treadle. As for the equipment actually used in this campaign, the Roman fleet consisted above all of round-bellied transports converted to warships, the dromons, vast in number, deep-draught and high in cargo capacity, fitted with bolt-throwing engines, stone-throwers and detachments of archers for landing; the sails were of linen, some dyed purple as a mark of imperial dignity. The land army wore the standard late Roman infantry kit, a short sword and a shield, supplemented by crossbowmen and artillerymen. On the Vandal side the equipment was chiefly small craft, together with vessels built for fire attack, their prows carrying jars of oil and sulphur, plus shore defences, apparatus for closing a harbour and the wall-mounted bolt-throwers of Carthage.
tactics: 羅馬的戰術核心是一整套以海運為骨架的會戰方案。艦隊先在皇都與西西里集結，再於7月一同轉入非洲海岸，抵達邦角外海時排成戰列，以船身與撞角橫掃汪達爾的小艇；海戰得手後，陸軍依計畫登岸，佔領對方營地並補充淡水與糧食，計畫沿海岸推進，轉攻迦太基。普羅科匹烏斯記述的登陸作戰是這一階段的重點：羅馬騎兵與步兵同時壓上，汪達爾分隊潰散，羅軍在營中取得大量補給。教訓出在錨地與部署上。巴西利斯庫把艦隊與陸軍的關係押在一次登陸成功上，卻在敵情未明的海灣裡把大船密集錨泊，給了火船可乘的潮流與可利用的密集目標。根瑟里克發動反制的步驟十分清楚：先以使者送入假情報，謊稱帝國的阿非利加軍隊已叛變並正向羅軍側翼逼近，迫使巴西利斯庫把艦隊從安全的開闊海面撤到岸邊海峽，等船群重新排定、火船已順著落潮流漂到下風；入夜後火船放出，用陶罐裡的油與硫磺點燃泊在密集船陣中的帆與索具，火焰沿相鄰船身蔓延，燒毀大批船艦，並在海面上造成大亂。這是一個典型的以欺敵、潮流與火船換時間的守方戰法，也說明羅軍此後在海峽與夜泊時的警惕與分隊編制，都是被這一夜燒出來的。
tacticsEn: The core of Roman tactics here was an operational plan for a set-piece battle built on sea transport. The fleet first assembled at the capital and in Sicily, then in July moved across to the African coast, and on arriving off Cape Bon formed line of battle, sweeping the Vandal small craft aside with hull and ram. Once the sea battle was won, the army landed as planned, occupied the opposing camp to take on fresh water and provisions, and was to advance along the coast and turn on Carthage. The landing described by Procopius is the hinge of this phase: Roman cavalry and infantry pressed forward together, the Vandal detachments broke up, and the Roman camp was supplied from what they took. The lesson lay in the anchorage and the deployment. Basiliscus staked everything on a single successful landing, yet in a bay where the enemy situation was unknown he anchored his great ships close together, giving the fire ships a tide to ride and a crowded target to work on. Genseric's counter-stroke followed a clear sequence: first a messenger carrying false news, claiming that the Roman army in Africa had revolted and was advancing on the Roman flank, forcing Basiliscus to move the fleet from safe open water into the coastal channel; then, once the ships had re-formed in line and the fire ships had drifted down the tide to the leeward, the fire ships were released at night, and the oil and sulphur in their jars set alight the sails and rigging of a closely anchored flotilla, the flame running along neighbouring hulls, burning a great part of the fleet and throwing the sea into confusion. This is a classic defensive method that buys time with deception, tide and fire, and it explains why the caution, night watches and squadron organisation that the Romans adopted afterwards in narrow channels and overnight anchorage were all born out of that night of fire.
data: 可核對的數字主要來自普羅科匹烏斯《戰爭史》第三卷：這支遠征軍有八百六十三艘船，步兵與騎兵各約十萬，另有數量相近的水手與海軍步兵負責划槳與登岸作戰；近代史家多認為這組數字帶有古代敘事的概數與誇張成分，較穩妥的判斷是艦隊確為數百艘的龐大編隊，兵力以萬計而非十萬之巨。時間線也可以標出：遠征軍於468年春末自皇都與西西里出發，7月抵達非洲海岸，海戰在7月25日發生；火船夜襲緊接其後，就在同一夜或翌日凌晨。運輸方面，羅馬依賴西西里與埃及的糧船輸送，艦隊每日消耗大量淡水，因此補給點的選擇成為戰術的關鍵變數。損失方面，海戰中汪達爾分遣艦隊覆沒，羅馬分隊損失有限；但夜襲之後，羅馬的大部分船艦被焚毀或損壞，人員方面多數游泳上岸獲救，兵員損失遠小於船艦損失。距離上，邦角與迦太基之間的海路在當時只是數日的短程航行，羅軍計畫中的下一個目標迦太基距戰場不過數十公里，若舟師得手，攻城的可行性曾被認為十分樂觀。
dataEn: The verifiable figures come chiefly from Procopius, Wars III: the expedition counted 863 ships, about 100,000 foot and about 100,000 horse, with a comparable number of sailors and marines for the oars and for the landing; modern historians generally treat these as round, and in part inflated, figures of the ancient manner, and the safer reading is a very large fleet of several hundred hulls with tens of thousands of men rather than the full hundred thousand. The timeline can also be fixed: the expedition left the capital and Sicily in late spring of 468, reached the African coast in July, and the sea battle was fought on 25 July; the fire-ship attack followed immediately afterwards, on the same night or in the small hours that followed. On the logistics side the Romans relied on grain ships from Sicily and Egypt, and the fleet consumed a great deal of fresh water every day, which made the choice of watering places a decisive variable in the tactics. On losses: in the sea battle the Vandal detachments were destroyed and the Roman squadrons suffered little; but after the night attack most Roman ships were burned or damaged, while on the personnel side most men reached safety by swimming ashore, so the loss of men was far smaller than the loss of ships. As for distances, the sea passage between Cape Bon and Carthage was a short run of a few days in that era, and the Roman plan aimed at Carthage lay only a few dozen kilometres from the battleground, so that had the fleet held, the feasibility of reducing the city was considered very good.
cause: 這場遠征的直接起因，是汪達爾王國在467年前後再度把掠奪推進到羅馬的阿非利加行省：根瑟里克的艦隊在巴利阿里群島與科西嘉、撒丁尼亞沿岸反覆出現，劫掠屬地與商船，467年更直接攻入阿非利加行省內地，沿海城鎮被掠，海上商路被切斷，羅馬的穀物漕運與稅收同時受損。再往前推，455年汪達爾已率軍進入意大利、劫掠羅馬城，把這筆舊賬變成一場帝國聲望與實力的共同羞辱；此後羅馬在466年曾以遠征軍（由馬塞利努斯、瓦倫提尼安與希爾德里克等人主持）反攻北非，奪回迦太基與周邊大片土地，把汪達爾壓回阿非利加的西部。為了維持這個局面，根瑟里克必須把反攻的浪潮頂回去，於是再度越過防線、襲擊帝國最富庶的屬地。遠征的政治背景同樣重要：里奧一世面對的不只是邊境戰事，而是帝國財政、首都糧價與軍心三方面的壓力；朝中元老多數認為應以海軍巡邏與外交，而不是傾國遠征來應對汪達爾，最後由於西西里與北非的形勢、以及汪達爾連續得手帶來的威脅，遠征方案獲得批准。於是468年春天，帝國把可調動的艦隊與主力部隊集中在西西里，準備以一次決定性的會戰取代此前零敲碎打的守勢。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the expedition was the Vandal kingdom pushing plunder once again into the Roman province of Africa around 467: Genseric's fleets appeared repeatedly off the Balearic Islands and along the coasts of Corsica and Sardinia, raiding both provinces and merchant shipping, and in 467 they struck deeper into Africa Proconsularis itself, coastal towns were taken, the sea lanes were cut, and Roman grain transport and taxation were damaged at the same time. Further back lies 455, when the Vandals marched into Italy and sacked the city of Rome, turning an old grievance into a combined affront to the prestige and the power of the empire. Rome had answered in 466 with an expedition under Marcellinus, Valerianus and Hilideric, which retook Carthage and a great part of the surrounding country and drove the Vandals back into western Africa; to hold that position, Genseric had to push the counter-offensive back, and so he crossed the line again and struck at the empire's richest province. The political background matters as much: Leo I was under pressure not merely from frontier war but from the empire's finances, the price of grain in the capital and the state of public morale. Most of the senate preferred naval patrol and diplomacy to an all-out expedition against the Vandals, but the situation in Sicily and North Africa, and the threat posed by the run of Vandal successes, carried the plan through. In the spring of 468 the empire concentrated the fleet it could muster and the bulk of its field army in Sicily, preparing to replace the war of attrition with a single decisive engagement.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接影響，是羅馬在466年剛剛奪回的北非攻勢被徹底扭轉。火船之後，帝國損失了這支有史以來最大的一次海軍集結中的一半以上，五世紀的西地中海不再有羅馬的制海權；此後羅馬沒有再組織同樣規模的遠征，改為在汪達爾內部尋找突破口，支持總督希爾德里克與汪達爾王室的爭端，最終在477年前後藉內訌重新取得迦太基與阿非利加行省的大部。第二層影響是羅馬與汪達爾的長期僵持成為常態：475年巴西利斯庫一度即位皇帝，其兄芝諾重掌朝政後，476至477年汪達爾再進軍意大利、兵鋒抵達羅馬，帝國只能以金錢換取退兵；同年西羅馬皇帝被廢，帝國的西半部就此終結，可以說468年的敗績為四十年後的終局埋下了伏線。第三層影響在戰術與技術層面：羅馬此後在海峽錨泊、夜間警戒與分隊編制上作了明確修正，敵方以火船與欺敵破壞大軍的戰例被寫進了拜占庭的經驗；與此同時，羅馬的遠征把帝國的人力、物力與菁英海軍消耗到極點，連年大規模調兵令東方行省與邊防兵力吃緊，汪達爾得以在沒有有效對手的情況下經營其地中海王國。
impactEn: The direct effect of the war was the complete reversal of the North African offensive that Rome had only just recovered in 466. After the fire ships, the empire lost more than half of what was by any measure the largest assembly of its navy in history, and the western Mediterranean in the fifth century was no longer a Roman sea. Rome organised no comparable expedition afterwards; it looked instead for a way in from inside the Vandal kingdom, backing the quarrel between the governor Hilideric and the Vandal royal house, and by about 477 recovered Carthage and much of Africa Proconsularis through that internal split. A second effect was that the long stalemate between Rome and the Vandals became the normal state of affairs: Basiliscus was emperor for a moment in 475, and after his brother Zeno returned to power in 476 and 477 the Vandals marched into Italy again and reached Rome, the empire able to buy their withdrawal with money; in the same year the last western Roman emperor was deposed and the western half of the empire ceased to exist, so the defeat of 468 can be read as a step toward the end state forty years later. The third effect lies in tactics and technique. The Romans afterwards made clear corrections in anchoring in channels, night watches and squadron organisation, and the case of an enemy breaking a great army with fire ships and deceit passed into Byzantine practice as experience. At the same time the expedition drained the empire of manpower, money and its best naval crews, and the repeated concentration of troops left the eastern provinces and the frontier garrisons thin, so that the Vandals were able to build their maritime kingdom with no effective rival to contest it.
result: 就邦角外海那一戰本身而言，結果是羅馬完勝：7月25日交鋒時，羅馬艦隊摧毀了汪達爾派出的分遣艦隊，陸軍登岸掃清其營地，汪達爾在近海的第一線海軍力量被清空。但整場戰爭的結果相反。根瑟里克沒有硬拼，他以假情報和火船把優勢還了回去，羅馬在隨後的夜襲中損失了大部分船艦，遠征的原始目標迦太基始終沒有被攻取，巴西利斯庫只能把殘兵與殘餘船隊帶回東方，468年的會戰以帝國在海上的徹底失敗告終。戰後羅馬內部為此付出了代價：巴西利斯庫在475年一度被推上皇位，很快即被推翻，證明遠征的失敗已成為宮廷鬥爭的籌碼。從更長的視角看，468年之後雙方都沒有能力再單方面解決對方，羅馬只能扶植汪達爾內部的反對派，希爾德里克在477年前後重新奪回迦太基，但汪達爾王國依然存在於北非，直到534年才被查士丁尼的帝國最終滅除。於是這場戰爭的最終結果，是把羅馬在北非的短暫復國變成了一段插曲，而汪達爾人留在迦太基，作為地中海世界一個獨立而持久的北岸強權。
resultEn: Taken on its own, the battle off Cape Bon was a complete Roman victory: on 25 July the Roman fleet destroyed the Vandal detachment sent out against it, the army landed and cleared the opposing camp, and the Vandal first line of sea power in those waters was wiped out. The outcome of the war as a whole was the reverse. Genseric did not stand and fight; he gave the advantage back with false intelligence and fire ships, the Romans lost the greater part of their fleet in the night attack that followed, and the original objective, Carthage, was never taken. Basiliscus could only lead the remnant of his troops and ships back to the east, and the campaign of 468 ended in complete failure at sea for the empire. Afterwards Rome paid for it at home: Basiliscus was pushed onto the throne in 475 and was overthrown again almost at once, which shows how completely the failure of the expedition had become a piece of the palace struggle. In the longer view, after 468 neither side could settle the matter alone. Rome could only back the factions inside the Vandal kingdom; Hilideric recovered Carthage around 477; and the Vandal state nonetheless survived in North Africa until it was finally destroyed by Justinian's empire in 534. The final result of this war was thus that the brief Roman recovery of North Africa became an episode, while the Vandals stayed at Carthage as an independent and durable power on the northern shore of the Mediterranean world.
